symptom: `mxcli run --local --page-check --screenshot-user U --screenshot-password P` reported every secured page as `title="Login"` — the verdict described the sign-in form, not the page asked for; adding `--screenshot` made it sign in
cause: the boot step that signs in and saves the Playwright storage state was gated on `opts.Screenshot && opts.ScreenshotUser != ""`; `--page-check` (added later, ako/mxcli#614) reuses that storage but was never added to the gate, so it probed anonymously
fix: gate the sign-in on `(Screenshot || PageCheck) && ScreenshotUser != ""`; the page probe is now shared with `mxcli playwright check` (docker.ProbePages), which also treats a 401 or the sign-in form as a failure instead of a page
insight: A flag that consumes state produced by another flag's setup step silently degrades when used alone. The verdict looked healthy (title, text, console-errors=0) because the login page IS a healthy page; the tell is the title. `playwright check` now fails on `#usernameInput` or a 401 so the same mistake cannot pass
test: manual on a scratch 11.13.0 app (run --local --page-check --screenshot-user pc_user: `Logging in as "pc_user"` then the Items verdict with rows=2); unit coverage of the login-form failure in `cmd/mxcli/docker/pagecheck_check_test.go`
